name: 实心肝叶外缘
pivotSuggestion: top-center for hanging pieces; contact top-center for terrain; center for landmarks
qaFindings: 实心肝叶外缘无隧道或空腔，暖褐色块面与肺心域区分；装饰层不自动赋予碰撞。
需root完成统一比例、透明深浅底和确定性房间合成验收；未作为已验收入库。

generationRequest.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated 2D game environment sprite on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, reference-guided redraw. Image1 supplies intended organ material and shape language; Image2 is the established delivered asset's matte gouache, clean dark ink contours, fine hand-painted texture and side-view only, do not copy its anatomy. Side-scrolling camera, very slight top-face visibility only where appropriate. Draw one complete coherent object with about 8% clear transparent padding, no scene, no floating multiple objects, no contact shadow or colored haze outside the silhouette. Full object uncropped. No characters, creatures, shelters, lamps, red ropes, rewards, symbols, labels, UI, ground patch, water or backdrop. No human stonework or invented portals.  Subject: ONE complete outer edge of a solid dead whale liver lobe used as a layered organic landmark in region R3, 20 hero units wide. Long broad rounded heavy tapered liver-shaped mass, deep brown-red and muted ochre at the upper curved rim, dense solid organ surface, shallow leathery creases and soft lobulated volumes. A few very short attached ochre connective tissue flaps. Absolutely solid filled silhouette: NO cave, no hollow organ, no tunnel, no arches, no stone pores, no ribs or baleen. Adapt the reference warm brown-red organs but not its level platforms or props. Side-view organic slab with softly curved upper profile, no flat walkway.

method: 内置 imagegen 逐件生成或参考引导静态状态修改；原始 PNG 未裁切、降噪或抠图。
